description: This file defines the ObjectGenerator class responsible for creating sample objects of various types, including simple, complex, collections, tuples, dictionaries, and enums, primarily for testing or sample data generation within the HelpPage area of a .NET application.

classes.name: ObjectGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates sample objects of various data types, including support for collections, tuples, dictionaries, enums, and complex objects, with internal logic to handle object creation and property/field setting.

classes.name: ObjectGenerator.SimpleTypeObjectGenerator
classes.description: A nested class responsible for generating simple data types with sample values, such as integers, strings, booleans, and URIs.

methods.name: GenerateObject
methods.description: Public method to generate an object of a specified type, initializing it with sample data.

methods.name: GenerateObject (private overload)
methods.description: Internal recursive method that creates objects of various types, handling collections, generics, and complex objects, with reference tracking to handle circular references.

methods.name: GenerateGenericType
methods.description: Handles creation of generic types such as Nullable, KeyValuePair, Tuple, and collections.

methods.name: GenerateTuple
methods.description: Creates a tuple object with sample data for each element.

methods.name: IsTuple
methods.description: Checks if a type is a Tuple of any arity.

methods.name: GenerateKeyValuePair
methods.description: Creates a KeyValuePair object with sample key and value.

methods.name: GenerateArray
methods.description: Creates an array of a specified type and size with sample data.

methods.name: GenerateDictionary
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with sample key-value pairs.

methods.name: GenerateEnum
methods.description: Returns a sample value from an enum type.

methods.name: GenerateQueryable
methods.description: Creates a IQueryable object with sample data.

methods.name: GenerateCollection
methods.description: Creates a collection (list, array list, etc.) with sample data.

methods.name: GenerateNullable
methods.description: Creates a nullable type with sample data.

methods.name: GenerateComplexObject
methods.description: Creates an instance of a complex object, setting its properties and fields with sample data, handling reference tracking.

methods.name: SetPublicProperties
methods.description: Sets all writable public properties of an object with sample data.

methods.name: SetPublicFields
methods.description: Sets all public fields of an object with sample data.
